source.description.zh-Hans: vomic 漫的推荐区常见中文短篇、日常漫画和同人创作，也能找到以 FGO 等游戏为题材的安科与 AA 连载。
source.description.zh-Hant: vomic 漫的推薦區常見中文短篇、日常漫畫和同人創作，也能找到以 FGO 等遊戲為題材的安科與 AA 連載。
source.description.en: Vomic features Chinese shorts, slice-of-life comics and fan works, including AA and dice-driven serials inspired by games such as Fate/Grand Order.
